title: Apocalypse R
description: zombie apocalypse modpack that was made with multiplayer in mind
body:
a Zombie apocalypse modpack where the zombies are dangerous and the aesthetics are great. Don't forget to enable The Lost Cities when creating a new world. Play this modpack on hardcore with your friends and have fun
